annotations.title: Where does this company's revenue come from, and how is the mix moving?

description: Use when the user names a public company and asks how its revenue splits (by platform, revenue type, channel, product or region) or whether its mix is shifting, for example toward mobile, live services or digital. Returns every revenue split the company files that adds up to reported revenue across its three latest 10-Ks, with each fiscal year's shares and dollar values and each filing's citation, from SEC EDGAR XBRL as filed. If the company files no split this run can verify, it refuses before you are charged. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first.
